questions.stem:
Karanta wannan labari, sannan ka amsa tambayar da ke ƙasa.

Aisha yarinya ce mai shekara goma sha huɗu. Tana zaune a Kano tare da iyayenta. Mahaifinta manomi ne, mahaifiyarta kuma tana sayar da kayan abinci a kasuwa. Kowace safiya, Aisha tana share gida kuma tana ɗebo ruwa kafin ta tafi makaranta. Tana son karatu sosai saboda tana so ta zama likita.

A ina Aisha take zaune?
questions.explanation: Labarin ya ce tana zaune a Kano (She lives in Kano).

questions.stem: Wanne a cikin waɗannan harafi ne mai ƙugiya (hooked letter)?
questions.explanation: Hausa hooked letters are ɓ, ɗ, ƙ and ƴ.

questions.stem: Fassarar "water" da Hausa ita ce

questions.stem: Fassarar "I am going to school" da Hausa ita ce

questions.stem: Fassara ta baka (oral interpretation) ana kiranta

questions.stem: Kashi na farko na insha'i shi ne

questions.stem: Kashi na ƙarshe na insha'i shi ne
questions.explanation: Kammalawa is the conclusion.
